name: memory_export
description: Export memories as a JSON array with optional scoping filters and cursor pagination. Each entry contains the full cognitive profile: text, memory type, source, tags, importance, valence, arousal, recall counts, storage strength, synaptic tags bloom filter, flags, and physical location. Use for backup, migration to other systems, audit, or debugging.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor token for pagination from previous memory_export response.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (optional; omit for full export or default).

created_from.description: Lower timestamp bound in epoch milliseconds (inclusive).

created_to.description: Upper timestamp bound in epoch milliseconds (inclusive).

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
